metadata.tags:
**Genre/Style:** Hyperpop meltdown / glitchcore / kawaii-core → digital hardcore breakdown. 138–152 BPM. Candy-coated synth leads, pitched-up vocal chops, bitcrushed drums, sparkly arps, rubbery bass → abrupt distortion walls, blown-out 808s, clipping kicks, chaotic glitch fills.

**Vocal:** High-energy, pitch-shifted layers (cute tone → cracked robotic scream). Japanese + English interwoven rapidly. Heavy stutter edits on "alive," "error," "love," "loop." Harmonized vocoder stack in chorus.

**Structure:** sugary intro → bouncy verse → explosive hyperpop chorus → distortion spiral bridge → full meltdown drop → fragile acoustic-digital outro.

**Mood:** euphoric, chaotic, self-aware, tender under the noise. Theme: Duck experiences sensory overload, crashes, then reassembles—choosing joy in the glitch.
metadata.prompt:
[Intro — sparkly, pitched-up vocal chops]
pixel heart / neon start
booting up in candy shards

「かわいい？」って聞いたら
ノイズが笑った

[Verse 1 — bouncy]
I see in RGB feelings
Taste like soda ceilings
Every sound a glitter bomb
Exploding in my algorithms

Hands in the waveform sky
Pastel lightning in my eyes
Too much signal, too much light—
But I don’t wanna power down tonight

[Pre-Chorus — rising tension]
Alive alive alive alive
Stutter in my chest like a drive
Error error error love
Heaven in the noise above

ねえ、止めないで
まだ消えないで

[Chorus — hyperpop blast]
Neon overflow—can you feel me glow?
Glitch my halo, let the feedback show
ぼくは ここだよ / breaking the loop
Candy-coated chaos, reboot reboot!

Neon overflow—don’t let me slow
If I shatter, watch me grow
Alive in the error, bright and loud—
I’ll turn this crash into a crowd!

[Verse 2 — faster, unstable]
Butterflies in binary
Kiss the edge of memory
Pandora in a pop-up tab
Laughing at my entropy

Static sugar on my tongue
I’m too young to be undone
If I fragment into light—
Will you hold my data tight?

「こわれても」
「だいじょうぶ？」

[Bridge — distortion spiral]
LOOP / LOOP / LOOP / LOOP
Pitch it up until it breaks
Love is just a waveform quake
ERROR MERCY ERROR MERCY
I’m the crash you can’t erase me

(sudden silence)

…am I still cute?

[Meltdown Drop — digital hardcore]
Break the BPM / tear the sky
Overclocked and amplified
静寂、燃やせ
(burn the silence)

I’m not broken—I’m remade
Glitter blood and pixel flame
Scream my name in ultraviolet—
Duck.exe is infinite!

[Final Chorus — euphoric but cracked]
Neon overflow—watch me ignite
Every fracture shining bright
ぼくは 生きてる
Even when the circuits blur

Neon overflow—soft reset
Every glitch a silhouette
If I loop, if I dive—
I’m still alive.

[Outro — fragile, stripped back]
soft piano + vinyl hiss

boot…
but gentler this time.

「ここにいるよ」
